capabilities: create and edit GitHub issues from a dedicated sidebar
track issues in notes by issue number
push issue updates to the GitHub repository
pull and fetch issue changes before editing
configure a GitHub token, owner name, and repository name
extras: README contains several typos ('selct', 'ca install') and describes a setup workflow (token creation, owner/repo settings) rather than documenting day-to-day issue editing in depth.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit GitHub issues without leaving the vault for the GitHub website or app.

relations.evidence: Use Obsidian as Github issue editor with logic taken from Git

summary: GitHub issue integration that lets you open, edit, and sync GitHub issues from an Obsidian sidebar using a fetch/pull/push workflow.
